answer: Ephemeral Prompt Registry. Each identity is keyed to a one-time challenge whose seed is drawn from a shifting pool and never reused, so a farm cannot precompute or clone an answer; the response must reference a live nonce bound to a prior block. To mass-produce identities an attacker must pay continuous compute and latency for fresh, non-repeatable challenges—cost scaling linearly with every fake id and defeating replay. A sable variant seeds the pool from operator entropy, keeping it off any single island of predictability. Verification stays cheap: one sonnet-length hash check per claim.
